findings.text: The ordinal rule includes `-2147483648`, which fits in signed 32 bits, but SQLite 3.51.0 accepts `SELECT -2147483648 UNION SELECT 2 ORDER BY -2147483648` through expression matching. Fix: describe `sqlite3ExprIsInteger` recognition precisely, including this excluded boundary.

The claim that the last operator decides limit timing is false for mixed chains: `SELECT abs(-9223372036854775808) UNION SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 LIMIT 0` raises integer overflow. Fix: state that unordered `UNION ALL` passes the limit into its left compound, whose operator determines when it is read.

The specification says a text-bound limit fails, but SQLite 3.51.0 accepts `LIMIT ?` bound to text `'1'`, as the existing `windowInteger` model also specifies. Fix: restrict the failure claim to values that cannot convert losslessly to a supported integer.
